FAQs
Do you count spam toward my total calls?
No. We automatically detect and block spam, telemarketing, and political robocalls so they never count against your plan.
Can I keep my current phone number?
Yes. You can forward calls from your cellphone, landline, or VoIP number to Upfirst with no porting required.
What does the free trial include?
Full access to every feature in your selected plan for 14 days. You can forward real calls and test responses with no commitment.
Do I have to sign a contract?
No contract. Cancel anytime, no questions asked.
How does the setup process work?
Most customers are live in under 15 minutes. We walk you through configuration during onboarding and you can forward your number whenever you're ready.
Does Upfirst integrate with my CRM?
Yes. Upfirst connects with HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, and 195+ other CRMs through native or Zapier integrations.
Does Upfirst integrate with my calendar?
Yes. Upfirst books appointments directly to Google Calendar, Outlook, Cal.com, and Calendly.
Do you offer customer support?
Yes. Email and chat support is available 7 days a week. Pro and Scale plans include priority response times.
